description: Defines a class 'LaunchCounter' that manages app launch tracking for prompting user ratings based on launch count and days elapsed.

classes.name: LaunchCounter
classes.description: A class to track app launch count and determine if the app is ready to prompt for a rating.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a LaunchCounter with a specified UserDefaults (default is .standard).

methods.name: isReadyToRate
methods.description: Computed property that returns true if the app has been launched enough times and enough days have passed since first launch to prompt for a review.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Increments the launch count, sets the first launch date if not set, and returns the current launch count.
